verdict.rationale: Paxos documents registrable webhook endpoints for asynchronous platform events, configured with event types, auth and rate limits. Orchestration (mint/redeem) webhooks fire on top-level and granular status transitions, with 24-hour retries, a List Events API for recovering missed deliveries, and a Dashboard test feature. Missing for 10: cryptographic payload signing (only API-key/OAuth endpoint authentication is documented), an explicit event catalog naming payment-confirmed, payout-settled and conversion-executed events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
